Under axis row L5.4, each new suppression counts as a finding. Low severity because the runtime behaviour is unchanged.
findings.claim: ensureSize hides its size/__iterate reads and its write to size behind three new @ts-expect-error comments instead of giving the parameter a type that declares them.

findings.evidence: `wholeSlice(begin: number, end: number, size: number)` tests `end === undefined` and `size !== undefined`. `resolveIndex(index: number, size: number, ...)` tests `index === undefined` and `size === undefined`. `resolveBegin`/`resolveEnd` pass these through. `SetRef(ref: Ref)` guards with `if (ref)`.
